forbidden.name: domain-not-to-shells
forbidden.comment: ADR-006: the domain layer knows no shell.

forbidden.name: shell-not-to-other-shell
forbidden.comment: ADR-006: a shell never imports another shell.

forbidden.name: studio-module-isolated
forbidden.comment: ADR-006: a Studio module (studio/<group>/<module>) imports neither sibling modules nor the other group.

forbidden.name: module-isolated
forbidden.comment: ADR-006: a module (<shell>/<module>) of platform, me or public imports no sibling module.

forbidden.name: packages-not-to-apps
forbidden.comment: ADR-006: packages never import application code.

forbidden.name: contracts-independent
forbidden.comment: ADR-006: contracts depend on no other workspace package.

forbidden.name: ui-no-business-data
forbidden.comment: ADR-006: ui knows no business data (no contracts, no mocks).

forbidden.name: mocks-only-to-contracts
forbidden.comment: ADR-006: mocks may depend on contracts only.
